<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"45f89244670fec0d816619433e702cedbcda43c39d58cb7dfc89be8e771fb486"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — serienstream.to episode pages load popunder ad tags (al5sm.com, nap5k.com — already blocked at baseline) and the site itself announces 4-6 ad pop-ups per video, matching the reporter's clicking-to-play pop-ups; but the play flow sits behind an ALTCHA/Cloudflare verification modal whose submit no tool may perform, so no pop-up could be rehearsed (popupsOpened 0 in every apply_rule phase) and the candidate stayed browser-unverified. Carried for a human:⁠ extend the site family's existing shared scriptlet to the reported domain — serienstream.to,s.to,serienstream.sx#⁠%#⁠//scriptlet('prevent-addEventListener', 'click', 'window.open') in BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt.

## Candidate for review

`serienstream.to,s.to,serienstream.sx#%#//scriptlet('prevent-addEventListener', 'click', 'window.open')`

BaseFilter/sections/general_extensions.txt

Not verified: Pop-up behaviour could not be reproduced or measured. Clicking a playback server only opens the site's 'Video wird vorbereitet...' ALTCHA/Cloudflare verification modal, and the form submit that would load the stream is refused by the interaction tool, so the step that spawns the pop-ups is unreachable; rehearsals reported popupsOpened:⁠ 0. apply_rule was inconclusive with failedCandidateChecks empty - its pixel review called the verification gate and empty player 'remaining' (symptom not_resolved), which a screenshot cannot judge for a tab-opening defect - and the corrected-revealSteps rerun was skipped (baseline_symptom_absent). Full-page vision confirmed the page but classified an anti-bot challenge. 2 candidate attempts remain.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/41938064155

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — No rule is justified for iz.ru/news:⁠ iz.ru is already in the shared `##div[id^="adfox_"]` rule that hides the reported "Реклама" slot (RussianFilter specific.txt:⁠1225), my duplicate candidate was rejected by validation, and the other named element is iz.ru's own live-broadcast iframe. The full-page inventory and the DOM measurement disagree about whether the bare band renders, so the run ends analysis-only for a maintainer to confirm.

## Still visible after the rule

- Upper-right column beside the lead story:⁠ “ПРЯМОЙ ЭФИР / АКТУАЛЬНЫЕ НОВОСТИ” live video player — The live video player remains visible in the upper-right column, matching the reporter’s complaint that the video player at the top right is not removed.
- Top content-width horizontal band at the top of the main page, above the lead story and below the header/news ticker, spanning the main content column — Empty reserved advertising band with visible divider/frame and faint “Реклама” label; no ad creative, video, or other content fills the space. The left edge is partly obscured by the subscription notification overlay.
- Top-right column, directly above the “Последние новости” sidebar — Live video player panel labeled “ПРЯМОЙ ЭФИР / АКТУАЛЬНЫЕ НОВОСТИ” with a purple cube/play graphic remains visible in the right-hand column.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"ba63e2fc6b0a5928c59d59bc0170148721a412761bae89a92f163a02e51e276d"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The report names three Supercell telemetry hosts (report.mkt.supercell.com, init.mkt.supercell.com, collector.snowplow.supercell.com) that no filter list in the repository covers, but they are app-side requests:⁠ the reported Google Play listing loads nothing from supercell.com and shows no matching defect, so apply_rule could not judge any block of them. I carry ||mkt.supercell.com^ (covering two of the three reported hosts, for SpywareFilter/sections/mobile.txt) to human review as browser-unverified.

## Candidate for review

`||mkt.supercell.com^`

SpywareFilter/sections/mobile.txt

Not verified: apply_rule refused to judge the candidate:⁠ environmentExperiment "inconclusive", validationSkipped true, errorKind "baseline_symptom_absent" — the reported Google Play listing page makes no request to mkt.supercell.com (or any supercell.com host; HAR artifact:⁠har:⁠99a9b367-737f-4a4e-baf7-0a4b7be996c2, 62 requests), so the proposed block has nothing to stop there. The reported tracker contacts come from the Supercell app's own traffic inside AdGuard for Android's VPN filtering, which this browser session cannot produce (the session is confined to the reported origin; an attempt to open an app-owned site was refused as off-origin). The rule was not rejected for its form or content — it simply cannot be exercised against the reported URL. Coverage:⁠ report.mkt.supercell.com and init.mkt.supercell.com are both matched by this rule; collector.snowplow.supercell.com is not and would need a rule of its own.

## Artifacts

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://www.fanfiction.net/s/11644460/4/Secret-Santa](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fanfiction.net%2Fs%2F11644460%2F4%2FSecret-Santa) ### Comment > **Problem:** On story pages, clicking the cover image should open a pop-up with the larger image. With AdGuard enabled, the page dims (backdrop appears) but the pop-up itself stays hidden. > > **Steps to reproduce:** > 1. Open https://www.fanfiction.net/s/11644460/4/Secret-Santa (any story with a cover image works) > 2. Click the cover image at the top left > 3. The page dims, but no image pop-up appears > > **Culprit rule (AdGuard Base filter):** > ~dogdrip.net,~smsonline.cloud##div[id^="img_"][style$="display: block;"] > > It matches FFnet's legitimate cover modal: > <div id="img_large" class="hide modal fade in" style="color: black; display: block;" aria-hidden="false"> > > **Confirmed workaround:** > fanfiction.net#@#div[id^="img_"][style$="display: block;"] > > **Suggested fix:** add `~fanfiction.net` to the rule's domain exclusions, or narrow the selector. ``` Username: @aGnamZer0 ``` ### Screenshots

### Issue URL (Social Widget) [https://www.itpassportsiken.com/s/kakomon/23_toku/q5.html](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.itpassportsiken.com%2Fs%2Fkakomon%2F23_toku%2Fq5.html) ### Comment > Hi, > > On AdGuard for iOS, the social share widget in <div class="social-btn-list_mini"> ("問題をシェア") remains visible on websites. > > The element is server-rendered in https://www.itpassportsiken.com/s/kakomon/23_toku/q5.html > > <div class="social-btn-list_mini">問題をシェア > <a class="social-btn tw-btn" ...></a> > <a class="social-btn fb-btn" ...></a> > <a class="social-btn ln-btn" ...></a> > <a class="social-btn link-btn" ...></a> > </div> > > > The only rule covering this element is the generic cosmetic rule in the AdGuard Social Media filter: > > ``` > ##.social-btn-list_mini > ``` > > On the iOS/Safari build, this generic rule is disabled for these domains by the AdGuard Japanese filter's `$generichide` exceptions: > > ``` > @@||fp1-siken.com^$generichide > @@||fp2-siken.com^$generichide > @@||fp3-siken.com^$generichide > @@||ap-siken.com^$generichide > @@||db-siken.com^$generichide > @@||fe-siken.com^$generichide > @@||itpassportsiken.com^$generichide > @@||nw-siken.com^$generichide > @@||pm-siken.com^$generichide > @@||sc-siken.com^$generichide > @@||sg-siken.com^$generichide > @@||takken-siken.com^$generichide > ``` > > These exceptions are inside a platform conditional in `JapaneseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt` (lines 706-723 in master): > > ``` > !#if (adguard_ext_safari || adguard_app_ios || adguard_ext_android_cb) > ... > !#endif > ``` > > So they apply on AdGuard for iOS, but not on the desktop/extension builds. > > The existing domain-specific rule in the Social filter only matches a `ul` element: > > fp1-siken.com,fp2-siken.com,fp3-siken.com,ap-siken.com,db-siken.com,fe-siken.com,itpassportsiken.com,nw-siken.com,pm-siken.com,sc-siken.com,sg-siken.com##ul[class^="social-btn-list"] > > The actual element on this page is a `div`, so this rule does not match. With the generic rule disabled by `$generichide`, nothing hides the widget. > > Verified in the iOS filter build (2026-11-04): > > - `https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/4.txt` line 14942: `##.social-btn-list_mini` > - `https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/4.txt` line 967: ...##ul[class^="social-btn-list"] > - `https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt` lines 1047-1058: `@@||fp1-siken.com^$generichide` ... `@@||takken-siken.com^$generichide` > > > Add a specific hide for the `div`. Specific cosmetic rules are not affected by `$generichide`: > > ``` > fp1-siken.com,fp2-siken.com,fp3-siken.com,ap-siken.com,db-siken.com,fe-siken.com,itpassportsiken.com,nw-siken.com,pm-siken.com,sc-siken.com,sg-siken.com,takken-siken.com##.social-btn-list_mini > ``` > > Alternatively, extend the existing rule's selector to [class^="social-btn-list"]. > > This does not require removing the `$generichide` exception. ### Screenshots
Screenshot 1 ![Screenshot 1](https://cdn.adguardcdn.com/sitereports/2hhv2gklz3eogok0w48swcwgogwcw84qoy07pelj28.jpg?nc=1)

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The "問題をシェア" share row on www⁠.itpassportsiken.com is a server-rendered div.social-btn-list_mini that the Social filter hides only via its generic rule, while the domain-specific rule for this exam-site family uses a ul-only selector; broadening that selector to [⁠class^="social-btn-list"]⁠ (SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt:⁠405) is the fix, but it could not be validated because the AdGuard CLI baseline already hides the element on this platform — the $generichide exceptions that expose the bug exist only in the iOS/Safari branch.

## Candidate for review

`fp1-siken.com,fp2-siken.com,fp3-siken.com,ap-siken.com,db-siken.com,fe-siken.com,itpassportsiken.com,nw-siken.com,pm-siken.com,sc-siken.com,sg-siken.com##[class^="social-btn-list"]`

SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: apply_rule returned environmentExperiment 'inconclusive' with errorKind 'baseline_symptom_absent' and validationSkipped:⁠ the candidate was never judged because the reported symptom is not present in the filtered baseline of this environment. On the AdGuard CLI build the generic Social filter rule #⁠#⁠.social-btn-list_mini (SocialFilter/sections/general_elemhide.txt:⁠127) is active — the div computes display:⁠none while the site's own stylesheet only sets layout on that class — whereas the Japanese filter's @⁠@⁠||itpassportsiken.com^$generichide exception sits inside the !#⁠if (adguard_ext_safari || adguard_app_ios || adguard_ext_android_cb) branch that this desktop proxy build does not include. The complete full-page capture of the same session confirms no visible share row (reporterSymptomPresence indeterminate, 0 instances). No visual review verdict was produced and no review rejected the rule; the gap is the iOS/Safari platform conditional, which cannot be reproduced through the CLI proxy.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — www⁠.nogame.pl gates the storefront at load with its own cookie-consent panel over a full-viewport dark mask; the domain-scoped element-hiding rule `nogame.pl##.consents__mask, .consents__modal` was verified in the browser extension (symptom resolved, page integrity intact), so it belongs in the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter. ## Rule `nogame.pl##.consents__mask, .consents__modal` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The reported defect is a first-party cookie-consent gate shown over the storefront — an annoyance, not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not an anti-adblock wall — so none of the instruction's closing rules applies. The filter policy has no rule against a cosmetic fix for a cookie notice; the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter exists for exactly this case and states that hiding the notice is usually sufficient. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/b19c58c7cea474ee38b2f00b1a174a6f75e11f96/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/41980030934 Automated analysis against filters at `b19c58c`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — fragisse.pl shows its own cookieconsent build's modal "Informacje dotyczące plików cookies" with a full-page dimming backdrop, and no enabled list — including the Cookie Notices filter — covers it, so the fix is to add fragisse.pl to the repository's existing shared `###cc--main` element-hiding rule; `fragisse.pl###cc--main` was validated on the reporter's settings profile with the notice gone and the page intact. ## Rule `fragisse.pl###cc--main` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-notice annoyance handled by the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter; the run instruction's close rules cover only the site's own advertising, paywalls and German anti-adblock walls, none of which applies. The screenshot and DOM show a cookie-consent dialog over a fully loaded shop page, not an anti-adblock wall that detects the blocker, and it is not the site's own advertising. A rule is needed:⁠ none of the reporter's enabled lists, including the Cookie Notices filter, hides this notice on fragisse.pl. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/21befffbf055cbaa2615fcb57f054f76b56d2c2d/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 55](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/21befffbf055cbaa2615fcb57f054f76b56d2c2d/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L55). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The perfumeriaonlyone.pl home page pins a first-party cookie-consent bar (div.awolg-consent-mode, fixed, z-index 9999, "Niniejsza strona wykorzystuje pliki cookies.") over the product grid, and no existing filter covers it. The domain-scoped hiding rule perfumeriaonlyone.pl#⁠#⁠.awolg-consent-mode was verified in the reporter's extension profile:⁠ the bar is hidden, the page keeps its layout and scrolling, and nothing remains. ## Rule `perfumeriaonlyone.pl##.awolg-consent-mode` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-consent notice (Annoyance), which no closing rule in the run instruction covers:⁠ it is not first-party advertising, not a paywall and not a German anti-adblock wall. Not an anti-adblock case, so the detector-script requirement does not apply; the annoyance is the cookie banner itself and a cosmetic rule resolves it. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/21befffbf055cbaa2615fcb57f054f76b56d2c2d/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — waszregion.pl serves its paid banner inventory first-party:⁠ ten .box-rotation-wrap ad slots with creatives under /_bannery/, injected by /js/reklamy.js, and no repository rule covers the site. Both hiding candidates removed every ad slot (adElementStatus visible→hidden, page integrity intact, no candidate damage), but the bound vision review still returned "rejected" after classifying editorial news cards and pre-existing unloaded image skeletons as remaining ads, so the rule reaches a human unverified.

## Candidate for review

`waszregion.pl##.box-rotation-wrap, .box-content-target, .async-partner-box`

PolishFilter/sections/specific.txt

Not verified: Both hiding candidates removed the whole ad family on the filtered baseline:⁠ apply_rule reported adElementStatus phaseB visible → phaseC hidden, pageIntegrity intact and observedDamage empty. The bound vision review nevertheless returned verdict 'rejected' with symptom 'not_resolved' and named remaining 'advertising' instances; re-analysis of the same phase-C tiles and the live DOM shows those to be editorial article/news cards (internal article links, category tags, no REKLAMA badge, outside every ad container) and pre-existing unloaded image/poster skeletons, which an ad rule must not hide. No further selector can change that verdict.

## Still visible after the rule

- Right sidebar of the top area, between the 'Jest umowa na Grafitową' news item and the 'Sport – Jaworzanka i Górnik II Polkowice' item — Advertising banner for the 'ZADBAJ O SERCE – ZADBAJ SERCE' / Dolny Śląsk campaign (heart graphic, partner logos, 'Zadbaj o serce i je dbaj – bez rejestracji!') still displayed inside the news sidebar column.
- Wiadomości grid, middle column to the right of the large MPWiK 'Akademia H₂O w Lubinie' lead card — Second 'ZADBAJ O SERCE – ZADBAJ SERCE' advertising banner rendered in the banner column beside the top news cards (above the small 'LUBIN' video card).
- Top-news grid under 'WR WIADOMOŚCI', right column next to 'Zmiany w budżecie i wyższe diety dla sołtysów' and '35 lat Straży Miejskiej w Złotoryi' — Red-headed 'WALCZYMY O NASZE PRZEDSZKOLE!' advertising banner with the 43 LATA / 100+ DZIECI / RODZICE statistics block still shown between the news sections, beside the SONDA poll card.
- Large white panel in the main column below the 'Biznes i Gospodarka' card rows, above the lower section heading and the 'Ostatnie komentarze' sidebar card — Oversized empty reserved advertising box left as a blank white panel with grey skeleton placeholder blocks (heading bar, one large block, two side blocks, three lower blocks); the ad slots are not filled with any creative.
- WR CO NAS CZEKA? sidebar card — Large blank reserved rectangle inside the 'Co nas czeka?' sidebar card, corresponding to the reporter-named ad box location; no ad creative or REKLAMA label is visible in this tile, but the empty placeholder block remains in place.
- and 3 more of the same, in the run artifacts

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"e1f96004a43bdf574a94d7a724fa9247c3006ddf7f905efb593462c9d3970da6"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The delayed Medium newsletter/sign-up popup ("Be the first to hear about new stories from Mike Puchol") on mikepuchol.com is confirmed present in the reporter-settings extension session (full-page vision, two tiles) after scrolling and waiting, and no rule covers the site; the cookie banner from the screenshot never rendered. apply_rule could not judge any candidate because its phase A navigation was refused twice with HTTP 403, so the best single rule is carried for human review.

## Candidate for review

`mikepuchol.com#%#//scriptlet('trusted-click-element', 'div[role="dialog"]:has(.pw-susi-modal) button[aria-label="close"]', '', '500')`

AnnoyancesFilter/Popups/sections/subscriptions_specific.txt

Not verified: apply_rule never judged the fix:⁠ phase A navigation of the reported URL returned HTTP 403 (http_blocked) on both calls and the host marked the candidate unjudgeable (retryable:⁠ false), so no phase produced screenshots, wheel test or vision verdict. The symptom itself is confirmed:⁠ complete full-page vision of the current prepared reporter-settings session reports the newsletter modal present in two tiles (y\~14720 and y\~15640). A hide-only #⁠#⁠ rule was not carried because, with the modal mounted, document.body carries inline style 'overflow:⁠ hidden' (null again once it unmounts), so hiding the overlay would leave the article unscrollable. This scriptlet clicks the dialog's own close button (div[⁠role=dialog]⁠ ⁠> button[⁠aria-label=close]⁠, found in the live DOM) so the site unmounts the modal and releases the lock itself; whether trusted-click-element still waits for a modal that mounts \~10-25 s after load remains unverified.

## Missing information

- Scriptlet parameter semantics for trusted-click-element (waiting/timeout) and set-style: The run's guidance documents (create-own-filters, filter-policy, CONTRIBUTING) served via lookup_rule_guidance contain no per-scriptlet parameter reference. I need to know whether `trusted-click-element` keeps waiting for its selector to appear and for how long (the popup on the reported site mounts \~10-25 s after load), and whether any scriptlet (e.g. `set-style`) can both hide a node and release a scroll lock in one rule. The AdguardTeam/Scriptlets wiki is not among the served documents.

## Artifacts

The reported element is a cookie/privacy consent notice, which the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter is expressly designed to block (filter policy, 'AdGuard Cookie Notices filter' section), and the reporter has that filter enabled, so a rule in that filter is the fix. No anti-adblock detector is involved (phase data reports antiAdblockDetected false), so the anti-adblock evidence gate does not apply either way. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/40906ec2cf995f5029a627bee993d23aab80b433/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The reported annoyance on primariabuzau.ro is the BeTheme cookie-consent overlay (.mfn-cookies:⁠ full-screen fixed panel with a dimming backdrop) covering the article. The Cookie Notices filter already hides that exact container on three other sites, so this validated rule (primariabuzau.ro#⁠#⁠.mfn-cookies) extends that shared family; the bound experiment confirmed the modal disappears and the page stays intact. ## Rule `primariabuzau.ro##.mfn-cookies` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-consent overlay, not the site's own advertising, so the 'first-party advertising' closing rule does not apply. No paywall is involved; the article text is present in the page and merely covered and dimmed by the consent overlay. The page is Romanian and shows a plain cookie consent dialog (Consimțământ / Detalii / Despre, Respinge / Personalizează / Permite toate); it is not a German anti-adblock wall, and the captured traffic contains no ad-blocker detector request, so the anti-adblock rules do not apply either. The AdGuard Cookie Notices filter exists to hide exactly this kind of overlay, so rule generation is allowed. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/363fb1339ab9e837122f13612b7ca05a5b89693a/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 2096](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/363fb1339ab9e837122f13612b7ca05a5b89693a/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L2096). ## Screenshots

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The gap above the Novinky.cz logo is the reserved wrapper of the top branding ad slot:⁠ the published rule hides the inner ad (div[⁠data-e2e="mol-advert"]⁠) but its parent keeps height:⁠226px, and the old sibling rule match was broken by the site renaming .ogm-branding-advert to .ogm-branding__advert. The validated fix restores that selector; the experiment removed the gap with page integrity intact. ## Rule `novinky.cz##.ogm-branding__advert + div:has(> div > div > .js-ad)` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The reported defect is ad-space residue from a third-party ad slot, not the site's own advertising, a paywall, or a German/any anti-adblock wall, so none of the instruction's closing rules apply. Filter policy permits blocking third-party advertising on a high-traffic site such as novinky.cz. The rule is a specific, domain-scoped cosmetic rule in existing published syntax, so it neither blocks the site's own advertising nor unblocks anything. ## Place in the list [BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/b14d847b98ef6e0402accf37182a2db8e3e4c3ac/BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 1534](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/b14d847b98ef6e0402accf37182a2db8e3e4c3ac/BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt#L1534). ## Screenshots

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — On www⁠.haberturk.com with the reporter's filter set, the structured full-page capture finds no reporter-defined ad block (symptom presence absent, zero instances):⁠ every ad container is empty or hidden, the site's cbgAds stub never runs (no ad frame, no ad request beyond those the baseline blocks), and the rotator's DoubleClick-tracked Halkbank/ets-banner creatives neither load nor paint. The reporter screenshot could not be matched to this page at all (it reads as a differently branded sports-score page), so I recommend closing as not reproduced rather than writing a rule for the empty 'REKLAM' placeholders that remain.

## Policy rationale

The run instruction's filter policy contains no rule that closes an ads report:⁠ it closes first-party self-promotion, paywalls and German anti-adblock walls, and requires a captured detector script for any other anti-adblock wall. None applies to a plain 'Ads' report, so rule generation was permitted throughout and the closure rests on the absence of the defect, not on a policy rule.

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — rainmojo.com serves its own fixed cookie-consent banner ("We value your privacy", Reject all / Accept all) as first-party HTML that no existing rule covers; adding rainmojo.com#⁠#⁠body ⁠> div:⁠has(#⁠cookie-consent-title) to the Cookie Notices filter's specific-rules section was verified to hide it with the page otherwise intact. ## Rule `rainmojo.com##body > div:has(#cookie-consent-title)` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-notice annoyance (the reporter has AdGuard Cookie Notices enabled), not first-party advertising, a paywall, or an anti-adblock wall, so none of the run instruction's close rules applies. The Cookie Notices filter policy states that hiding or blocking the corresponding scripts is sufficient in most cases; here the banner is first-party HTML with no consent-vendor request to block, so a cosmetic element-hiding rule is the appropriate fix. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/f6555423df56e78235de78871678ac8e0c34121a/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots

The reported defect was not reproduced

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported full-screen video/Shopee ad overlay on emochi.com was absent in complete full-page vision of the reported page and on the chat and wallet pages; the site's only ad-serving resource is the AdSense loader, which AdGuard Base filter already blocks. No new rule is needed, so a maintainer should verify and close this report.

## Policy rationale

None of the run instruction's closing rules applies:⁠ the reported creatives are third-party (a vertical video ad plus a Shopee PH shopping card), not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not an anti-adblock wall — no detector message or overlay asking to disable the blocker was seen. No rule is needed:⁠ the only ad-serving resource on the site is the Google AdSense loader, which AdGuard Base filter already blocks with ||pagead2.googlesyndication.com^ (engine-confirmed, 5 hits on exactly that URL). The reporter-defined symptom was absent in complete session-bound full-page vision of the reported URL, so the report carries reproductionStatus not_reproduced together with allow_rule_generation.

При включённой фильтрации для «Я.ТВ Веб-плеер»: реклама блокируется, но прогресс просмотра (номер серии и таймкод) не сохраняется. Подсказать, какой именно запрос (домен/путь/API‑эндпоинт) отвечает за синхронизацию прогресса просмотра в этом сценарии, чтобы можно было добавить точечное исключение и сохранить блокировку рекламы. > 2. Либо добавить в официальные фильтры корректное исключение, которое позволит одновременно блокировать рекламу и не ломать сохранение прогресса. ### Screenshots

comment.body:
<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"1b9403b1313741184e3c3dc2099d83ba4ad410273ac6aa6253c763351f3a5549"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Filtering really does break smartmeter.netz-noe.at:⁠ hiding the DataReporter consent dialog leaves the site's whole app-root inert, so Login, "Jetzt registrieren" and the navigation cannot be used. No single rule could be verified as the fix — the auto-deny scriptlet's effect is invisible to review, the `.cc-banner`-only exception renders a backdrop-less dialog (review:⁠ page integrity regressed), and the combined selector-list exception is not applied by the engine.

## Still visible after the rule

- Cookie-consent modal region below the site header, centered in the viewport (about x 538-1335, y 331-757 in the reporter screenshot) — The DataReporter cookie-consent dialog 'Unsere Webseite nutzt Cookies' is entirely absent:⁠ no NÖ Netz/EVN logo block, no explanatory cookie text, no 'Details anzeigen', no 'Nur erforderliche Cookies erlauben' and no 'Alle Cookies erlauben' buttons, and no dimming backdrop are rendered anywhere on the page. The cookie decision therefore can never be made on the page, and the content that the gate controls (Login form, 'Jetzt registrieren', top navigation) is presented without any consent control or substitute, so the consent-gated functionality is still missing/broken.
- Center of viewport below the site header, over the welcome text and login panel — The expected cookie-consent modal (“Unsere Webseite nutzt Cookies”) and its dimming overlay are absent; no consent buttons or backdrop are visible, so the pending cookie decision cannot be made.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Missing information

- Cosmetic exception rules with a comma-separated selector list — syntax/behaviour undefined: This site's fix plausibly needs both culprits cancelled:⁠ the generic `##.cc-banner` (the DataReporter consent dialog) and `##.cookie-popup-overlay` (its backdrop). Because only one rule may be submitted, I tried the single rule `smartmeter.netz-noe.at#@#.cc-banner, .cookie-popup-overlay`. The element-hiding section of create-own-filters.md defines the selector as a "CSS selector" and shows only single-selector `#@#` examples; it never states whether a cosmetic EXCEPTION rule may carry a comma-separated selector list nor whether each list item cancels the matching generic rule. The engine reported the rule as applied but cancelled neither hiding rule (adElementStatus `.cc-banner, .cookie-popup-overlay` stayed `hidden` in phase C, `targetVisibleCount: 0` for both `#dr_cookie_banner_container` and `#dr_blocking_div`), so the question is practically important and could not be resolved from the supplied guidance.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/42038781938

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On www⁠.wellrx.com the site's own first-party cookie notice (`div.topPageCallout.callout.primary`, fixed at the bottom of the mobile viewport) is baked into the page HTML and stays visible with the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter applied. Adding `wellrx.com##.topPageCallout:has(> p a[href^="/privacy-policy"])` to the Cookie Notices filter hides it, verified with an intact page and the googler/gate symptom resolved. ## Rule `wellrx.com##.topPageCallout:has(> p a[href^="/privacy-policy"])` ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie notice annoyance; none of the run instruction's closing rules applies (it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall and not an anti-adblock wall). The AdGuard Cookie Notices filter's purpose explicitly covers hiding cookie notices, and hiding is sufficient here because no site function depends on the notice. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/1cb130085cf5a062af5f407c760fd3f31e5c74a1/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/42049966392 Automated analysis against filters at `1cb1300`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.
